mentions.name: Parallel text Reader
mentions.description: This is a parallel text reader for language learning that displays texts alongside their translations. Users can OCR pages from old books (e.g., Bengali) with Claude/Gemini, have the content translated into English or Sanskrit, and load it into the Reader. Theming and features were ported from the author's website, and the local reader will serve as a test bed for the website's Reader before its release this month.
mentions.problem: Existing parallel text readers were not satisfying, so the author designed their own to their liking.
mentions.source_excerpt:
= Language Learning =

I have tried a few parallel text readers and was not satisfied by any of them. My website (https://www.adhyeta.org.in/) had a simple baked-in interface that I deleted soon after I developed it. However, this weekend, I sat down with Claude and designed one to my liking. I also ported the theming and other goodies from the website to this local reader. This will serve as a test bed for the Reader on the website itself.

LLMs now produce wonderful translations for most works. You can take an old Bengali book, have Claude/Gemini OCR a few pages and then also have it translate the content to English/Sanskrit. Then load it into the Reader and you are good to go!

The Reader, I will release this month.
